name: The Him
source:
You come back home and enter your room. There’s a guy inside – he claims it’s his room. Everyone believes him. He’s slowly trying to take everything you have. What would you do?

[From [url=https://halkind.itch.io/the-him]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你回到家并进入你的房间。里面有一个人——他声称这是他的房间。大家都相信他。他正在慢慢地试图夺走你所拥有的一切。你会怎么办？

[来自[url=https://halkind.itch.io/the-him]Itch.io[/url]]
